digest.component_or_area: Backend port and adapter layer (RemoteRef contract)
propositions: RemoteRef.instance field is never populated in production code despite being documented as identifying concrete deployments; the port member remote_ref() must be declared and implemented on both backends with instance injected at construction time

RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira key alone, independent of instance; vendor field already separates Cloud from DataCenter
remote_ref() must read constructor-injected instance state rather than resolving settings at call time to avoid breaking contract tests and to maintain clean protocol semantics
Both ADRs 0055 and 0035 must be amended to correct docstring claims about instance preventing collisions and to document that RemoteRef is not persisted, making URL changes re-label nothing on disk
